concepts.label: C4Diagram
concepts.definition: A source-backed architectural view of a selected focus at system-context, container, component or code level, tied to a PublishedKnowledgeSnapshot and showing the evidence and gaps relevant to that view.

concepts.label: CodificationAssociation
concepts.definition: An explicitly recorded association identifying a published relationship as a codification of a runtime relationship while preserving both records and their provenance. It is not an equivalence assertion between endpoint entities.

concepts.label: ImpactAssessment
concepts.definition: An architect-authored, reviewable account of the likely effects of a change request across participating sources, identifying assessed elements, reasons, evidence, source revisions and unresolved gaps. It does not approve the request.

concepts.label: KnowledgeAnnotation
concepts.definition: Persistent human-authored context attached to an identified published entity, such as a business explanation, way of working or descriptive business RBAC information; it retains runtime provenance.

concepts.label: KnowledgeContributionChange
concepts.definition: A retained record of a successful creation, edit or removal of a runtime annotation or relationship, preserving its identity, acting user, time and affected content and provenance.

concepts.label: PublishedKnowledgeSnapshot
concepts.definition: An identifiable published baseline of source-owned knowledge, recording the participating source revisions against which entities and relationships are resolved.

concepts.label: RuntimeRelationship
concepts.definition: A persistent human-authored relationship between identified published entities, with stated meaning and runtime provenance, usable independently of repository codification.

concepts.label: SourceAccessGrant
concepts.definition: A source repository administrator's grant of read-only access to one division's App, which is that owner's consent to import the repository's whole committed ontology into that division's catalog and registers the repository as a source without steward approval.

concepts.label: SourceImportConfiguration
concepts.definition: Repository-owned committed configuration in a source repository that identifies its ontology path and namespace for import.

concepts.label: SourceImportStatus
concepts.definition: The catalog's per-source record of a granted source's state (current, invalid, not configured or access removed), last attempted commit, last published commit and any actionable failure reason.

concepts.label: StaffId
concepts.definition: The enterprise-wide staff number issued by the HR system and used as the internal primary key by older enterprise systems. Exactly 7 characters: U or N followed by 6 digits, case-insensitive and normalised to uppercase. Unique per member of staff, never reissued and never changed. The identity provider is its source of truth; applications read it from a token claim and do not edit it.
